ac.offer.p: With an account you can order next time without a code, your named addresses are kept and your cart is the same on every device.
ac.in.p: With an account, your addresses and cart go with you on every device.
ac.again: To create or sign in to an account, confirm your number with a code now.
ac.done: Your account is ready; this browser will remember you.
ac.keep: Keep this address with a name
ac.label: Address name (e.g. “Home”)
ac.cart.out: {n} cart items are out of stock for now.
ac.cart.out.1: 1 cart item is out of stock for now.
ac.media: Gate photo and voice note for this address
am.note: Optional: a gate photo and a few words help the courier find you faster. Only shops you order from with this address can see them.
am.err.mic: The microphone is not available or permission was not given.
am.err.bad_media_type: This file is not accepted; send a photo or a recorded voice note.
am.err.too_large: The file is larger than allowed.
